title: 第7章 它不死我睡不着啊第8章 这个时候投降你是在说笑吗
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
无论挡在面前的是荆棘、还是树木，都无法阻拦李凯南碾压一切的步伐。
密集交错的灌木荆棘被踏碎，变形的残枝倒伏在地。
成人合抱的树干被直接撞断，断裂处的木屑飞溅，树干轰然倒塌。
旋即便听到“砰”的一声闷响，那道黑影猝不及防之下被李凯南狠狠撞上。
这道黑影显然无法承受这样恐怖的力量冲击，整个身躯血肉如同豆腐一般碎裂开来！
只见黄昏夕阳之下，有血雾炸开，碎块飞溅。
李凯南身后的红色披风之上光芒闪烁，将飞溅出来的这些脏污血肉全都自动隔绝在外。
华丽的铠甲之上，此时居然没有沾染半点污秽！
追过来的老猎人便看到了这一幕，让他下意识张大了嘴巴。
尽管这一路上，他对于李凯南的强大已经有了一定的认知。
但是当他亲眼看到李凯南展示出自己的力量时，还是让老猎人感到无比震惊！
此时的李凯南站起身来，看着没有沾染半点血污的铠甲和披风，倒是不由满意地点了点头。
如果沾了血，对铠甲美观程度和后续保养都有一定影响……
嗯，魔法还真是方便呢！
老猎人从震惊中回过神来，连忙快步走来，看向李凯南的眼神带着无比的尊崇，欢喜地道：
“太好了，狼人被消灭了！”
李凯南闻言，也是微微一笑。
剧情应该过完了，接下来就可以招募npc，顺便领取奖励了……
但是下一刻，李凯南脸上的笑容却是一滞，转而眉头皱起。
系统的面板之上，并没有出现狼人被消灭的提示！

出bug了？
还是说……
李凯南的视线，在地上残存的这些血肉碎块中扫过。
看残存下来的血肉碎块，看得出来这是一只灰毛野狼。
狼人嘛，有狼和狼人两个形态也很正常。
只不过……
“巴伦，你们这边的狼人有五条腿吗？”
老猎人还没有意识到不对劲，只是摇头道：
“我从未见过有五个腿的狼人……”
李凯南点了点头，然后眯起眼睛看不出喜怒，只是语气幽幽地道：
“哦，那看来我们上当了！”
狡猾、果断、狠辣……
这玩意的智商还真不低啊！
老猎人听到李凯南这么说，愣了一下之后连忙俯身在地上的这些碎肉之中检查起来。
看到其中的四条野狼短肢之后，他也终于明白了李凯南的意思。
此前狼人已经被李凯南弄断了一条前腿……
所以这堆血肉碎块并不是狼人的！
皱眉沉默了片刻之后，老猎人忍不住道：
“如果它只是想逃跑，根本没必要这样麻烦……除非，它是想要引走我们！”
content_en:
No matter whether it was thorns or trees standing in front of him, nothing could stop Li Kainan from crushing everything.
The densely intertwined shrubs and thorns were trampled to pieces, and the deformed branches fell to the ground.
The tree trunk that the adults were hugging was directly broken, sawdust flew from the break, and the trunk collapsed suddenly.
Immediately after hearing a muffled "bang", the black figure was caught off guard and hit hard by Li Kainan.
This black shadow obviously couldn't withstand such a terrifying force impact, and the flesh and blood of its entire body shattered like tofu!
Under the dusk and setting sun, I saw blood mist exploding and fragments flying.
The red cloak behind Li Kainan flickered with light, automatically blocking out all the dirty flesh and blood splashed out.
The gorgeous armor is not stained with any dirt at this time!
The old hunter who was chasing after him saw this scene, which made him subconsciously open his mouth.
Although along the way, he already had a certain understanding of Li Kainan's power.
But when he saw Li Kainan display his power with his own eyes, the old hunter was still extremely shocked!
At this time, Li Kainan stood up, looking at the armor and cloak that were not stained by any blood, he couldn't help but nodded with satisfaction.
If it is stained with blood, it will have a certain impact on the aesthetics and subsequent maintenance of the armor...
Well, magic is really convenient!
The old hunter recovered from the shock, walked over quickly, looked at Li Kainan with incomparable respect in his eyes, and said happily:
"Great, the werewolves have been eliminated!"
Li Kainan also smiled slightly when he heard this.
The plot should be over, and then you can recruit NPCs and collect rewards...
But the next moment, the smile on Li Kainan's face faltered, and he frowned instead.
There is no prompt that the werewolf has been eliminated on the system panel!
Is there a bug?
Or should I say...
Li Kainan's eyes swept across the remaining pieces of flesh and blood on the ground.
Looking at the remaining pieces of flesh and blood, it was obvious that it was a gray-furred wild wolf.
As for werewolves, it’s normal to have two forms: wolf and werewolf.
It's just...
"Barron, does your werewolf have five legs?"
The old hunter didn't realize anything was wrong, he just shook his head and said:
"I've never seen a werewolf with five legs..."
Li Kainan nodded, then squinted his eyes and couldn't see the emotion or anger, but said in a quiet tone:
"Oh, it looks like we were fooled!"
Cunning, decisive, ruthless...
The IQ of this thing is really not low!
When the old hunter heard what Li Kainan said, he was stunned for a moment and then quickly leaned over to check among the pieces of meat on the ground.
After seeing the short limbs of four wild wolves, he finally understood what Li Kainan meant.
The werewolf had already had one of its front legs broken by Li Kainan before...
So this pile of flesh and blood fragments does not belong to the werewolf!
After frowning and remaining silent for a moment, the old hunter couldn't help but said:
"If it just wants to escape, there is no need to go to such trouble...unless it wants to lure us away!"
